job.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer II (Frontend Leaning)
job.description: LeafLink is the largest unified B2B cannabis platform, providing licensed cannabis businesses a suite of tools to manage their business more effectively, sell or order from their favorite brands and accelerate growth.
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain scalable frontend applications using Vue 3, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript tooling.
Own complex features from technical design through production release — UI, API, and the Python services behind them.
Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python to support product features.
Build reusable components, patterns, and frontend architecture that improve developer velocity.
Improve application performance, accessibility, responsiveness, and reliability.
Collaborate with product and design teams to translate requirements into high-quality user experiences.
Write high-quality tests across the stack using tools such as Vitest, Vue Test Utils, Playwright, and pytest.
Participate in code reviews and mentor engineers on frontend best practices.
Contribute to CI/CD improvements, observability, monitoring, and release quality.
Help maintain strong standards around security, privacy, and safe handling of user data.
Use AI-powered development tools, including Claude, to accelerate software design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and code review.

positioning: Prioritize bullets showing ownership, reliability, and cross-functional delivery impact.
project_suggestions: Highlight projects touching Vue, TypeScript, JavaScript
gap_analysis: Add quantified outcomes (latency, uptime, delivery speed, or cost savings) where possible.
